slots.label: Spin record (start)
slots.notes: The top of the hour: the needle goes down and the record gets the air.

slots.label: Banter during recordings
slots.notes: They talk OVER the record, the way the pair do when the music is running underneath.

slots.label: Angry messages from upstairs
slots.notes: Upstairs is ANGRY this time — the memo is a rocket, and the pair take it standing up.

slots.label: Banter without caller
slots.notes: No caller on this one — the two of them, alone, on whatever is in the room.

slots.label: Different news story
slots.notes: A DIFFERENT story from the one at the top of the hour — not the same lead said twice.

slots.label: Repeat (end)
slots.notes: The hour wraps here and begins again at the top.

kinds.label: News coverage
kinds.blurb: The pair take the wire — headlines pulled live, the lead story dug into and reacted to rather than read out (dj_news).

kinds.label: Spin a record
kinds.blurb: Not a round — the END of one. The needle goes down, the talk stops, and the record has the air for the rest of this entry (dj_skip).

kinds.label: Painting selling
kinds.blurb: The gallery press — paintings described from their actual pixels, argued over, priced absurdly and hawked to the listeners (dj_gallery_round).

kinds.label: Ad read
kinds.blurb: The commercial break: a stored read, a sponsor, or a fresh spot bedded in the station's own music (dj_ad_break).

kinds.label: Banter
kinds.blurb: The pair talking, with the speakbox seeding underneath (dj_banter).

kinds.label: Call with banter
kinds.blurb: A whole generated caller on the line — ring, name, voice, an arc, and an ending off the hang-up shelf (dj_call_generated).

kinds.label: Phone call
kinds.blurb: A call on the request line: one of his own requests read back to him by a stranger (dj_caller).

kinds.label: Message from upstairs
kinds.blurb: A memo down from the manager, read out on air and reacted to (dj_manager_note).

kinds.label: Recap on the hour
kinds.blurb: The pair take stock of the hour just gone, off the station's own log — what played, who rang, what sold.

kinds.label: Deep conversation
kinds.blurb: The long-form dig: one subject, taken further than it should be (dj_deep_round).

kinds.label: Side rant
kinds.blurb: Something off the shelf sets one of them off and the whole round becomes the rant (drop_bombshell into dj_banter).
